highlights_headline: The 3.119.3 preview fixes Linux ARM64 loading and reflection-disabled AOT initialization.
highlights_body: Bundled image and compression dependencies are refreshed, with additional Spectre mitigation flags for native SkiaSharp binaries.

bullets.detail: Correctly links the fontconfig runtime library, fixing native crashes involving the unresolved uuid_generate_random symbol.
SKBlender no longer uses reflection to enumerate blend modes during static initialization, avoiding TypeInitializationException when IlcDisableReflection=true.
Updates libpng to 1.6.54, libwebp to 1.6.0, Brotli to 1.2.0, and libexpat to 2.7.3. The Brotli and libexpat updates address reported decompression and parser issues.
Enables Spectre mitigation options for native SkiaSharp on Windows and Linux, using architecture-specific flags on Linux.

contributor_summaries.sshumakov: Spectre mitigation flags for Windows and Linux native SkiaSharp builds.

preview_summaries.v3.119.3-preview.1.1: Fixed Linux ARM64 fontconfig loading and reflection-disabled AOT initialization, refreshed bundled native dependencies, and added Spectre mitigation flags.
